name: realtime-notification
description: Realtime notification service: Kafka activity streaming, Redis prefs, SSE delivery

scripts.build: npm run build -w @rns/shared && npm run build -w @rns/api && npm run build -w @rns/worker && npm run build -w @rns/subscriber-stub
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rns/shared && npm run typecheck -w @rns/api && npm run typecheck -w @rns/worker && npm run typecheck -w @rns/subscriber-stub
scripts.test: npm run test -w @rns/shared && npm run test -w @rns/api
